title: Record step data
statement: Record-step data for $k$ work tapes, a state type $Q$, and a tag type $T$ consists of an optional state, a Boolean width flag, a Boolean position flag, an optional Boolean symbol for each tape, left-edge and right-edge Boolean flags for each tape, an optional tag, a Boolean native-input direction, and an optional Boolean input symbol. By default, the state, tape symbols, tag, and input symbol are absent; the width and native-direction flags are false, the position flag is true, and all edge flags are false.
